name: HYDRA-UMC-PATH-PLANNER-3D
notes: Real RRT-based 3D path planner, tested against real obstacle/workspace scenarios (not yet RRT* - no rewiring pass). Real wall-clock planning time limit (PlannerConfig.max_duration_ms) independent of max_iterations, a reusable obstacle/workspace test corpus, and a new `validate` subcommand that re-checks an externally-supplied path for safety (workspace bounds, obstacle clearance, segment-level collisions) before it is trusted for real execution.
